english.title: Fail to comply with duty to notify registrar of change of information regarding company secretary
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company to which Part 12 of the Companies Act 2006 applied and failed]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), to which Part 12 of the Companies Act 2006 applied and who was in default by failing]_

without reasonable excuse to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales about a change, including the date on which the change occurred, in the required information of

(C)_[the secretary]_
(D)_[one of the joint secretaries]_

of the company within 14 days of the change having occurred, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 279H and 279M of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales
in accordance with section 279H of the Companies Act 2006
of a change in the required information of a person
when that person was the secretary or one of the joint secretaries of a company

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A shadow director is treated as an officer of the company (section 279M(2)).
